data.text: For God alone my soul waits in silence; from him comes my salvation.
data.subtitulo: For the music director; according to Jeduthun. A psalm of David.

data.text: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my stronghold; I will not be greatly shaken.
How long will you assault a man, all of you battering him down like a leaning wall, a tottering fence?
They plan only to thrust him down from his high place; they delight in falsehood. With their mouth they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah.
Wait in silence for God alone, my soul, for my hope comes from him.
data.titulo: Personal Trust Opens into a Call to the People

data.text: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my stronghold; I will not be shaken.
My salvation and my glory rest on God; my strong rock and my refuge are in God.
Trust in him at all times, you people; pour out your heart before him. God is our refuge. Selah.
Common people are only a breath, nobles a lie; in the scales they rise, together lighter than a breath.
data.titulo: False Securities and the Judgment of God

data.text: Do not trust in extortion or set vain hopes on robbery; if wealth increases, do not set your heart on it.
Once God has spoken; twice I have heard this: power belongs to God,
and to you, Lord, belongs steadfast love, for you repay each person according to his work.
